features.featCheckIn_desc: A quick step at the counter before the ticket: client, device and problem in 30 seconds, and a slip for the client. Turn it into a ticket later in one click. Off: the Check-in page disappears and you create tickets directly (F3).
features.title: Features
features.featDeliveryReceipt_desc: When a repaired device is given back, offer to print a receipt: what was paid, what is left, the warranty end date and a line for the client's signature. A delivered ticket always has the "Delivery receipt" button.
features.featQuickCash_desc: Under "Amount paid", buttons with the bills the client probably gives (exact, 4000, 5000…). One click fills the amount and the app shows the change. You can still type the amount.
features.featDrawerFloat_desc: For shops that empty the drawer each evening and put a fixed amount in it each morning. The daily close then shows how much should be in the drawer (opening cash + today's cash).
features.featRepairmen_desc: Give a repair to a repairman paid per repair: a % of the profit (price − parts), a % of the price, or a fixed amount, or typed by hand on the ticket. His share is a cost of the repair; his page shows what the store owes him and you record when you pay him.
